game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, giant beetles strike the heartwood tree, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heartwood tree from giant beetles in Mossy Creek: keep the picks_right meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: picks_right drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Loop Picker
